formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) [x3 : DecidableRel x2.Adj], (∀ (x4 x5 x6 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x4 x5 → x2.Adj x5 x6 → ¬x2.Adj x6 x4) → (∀ (x5 x6 x7 x8 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x5 x6 → x2.Adj x6 x7 → x2.Adj x7 x8 → x2.Adj x8 x5 → x5 = x7 ∨ x6 = x8) → ∃ (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x6 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x6 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ ∧ (∀ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x7 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x7 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ → x6.size ≤ x7.size) ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.HasStarProfile x1 x2 x6
plain_statement: For G a graph with no triangle and no 4-cycle, F its edge function, circuits of AND and OR gates with at most two inputs: some least such circuit computing F has the star profile: every AND gate owns no edge, or all the edges it owns share one vertex (owning uv: true at the input with only u, v true, no AND strictly in its cone true there).
title: A step toward: On graphs with no triangle and no 4-cycle, some least AND/OR circuit of fan-in two for the edge function has every AND gate owning a star of edge
